items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: INTERVIEWER: That's what Streckfus still talks about him, Captain Vern Streckfus. INTERVIEWEE: Oh yeah, yeah, he was on the boat.

ctx.x: He was a great teacher. He played well. He was a man that could play soprano and the sweetest tone you ever heard. Marinet soprano, melliform, piano sites, no trumpet, he'd play everything and teach them all.
That's what Streckfus still talks about him, Captain Vern Streckfus.
Oh yeah, yeah, he was on the boat.
